core_concept: HTML elements are categorized as either block or inline based on their behavior and how they interact with surrounding content. Block elements occupy the full width available and force subsequent elements onto new lines, while inline elements only take up as much width as their content requires and flow within the line of text. Understanding this distinction is crucial for controlling layout and styling in web development.
